lineage.strategy: Add issuer guidance/expectations evidence distinct from prior regulatory backlog and cash-flow extraction.

observations.fact: Quanta reported Q2 2026 revenue of $9.56B versus $6.77B a year earlier, net income of $451.4M versus $229.3M, and raised full-year 2026 expectations to revenue of $39.3B-$39.7B, adjusted EBITDA of $4.09B-$4.21B and free cash flow of $2.0B-$2.5B.

risks.risk: Management explicitly flags weather, regulatory, permitting, supply-chain, inflation, interest-rate and recession risks to project timing and results; raised guidance remains forward-looking.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental margin and return contribution from recently completed acquisitions versus organic execution is not fully isolated by this release.

recommendation: Use as current source-addressed actual-versus-guidance execution evidence; Alpha retains scoring and valuation authority.
